description: This file defines the Exception class for the PHPMailer project, providing an exception handler with a custom method for formatting error messages.

classes.name: Exception
classes.description: Custom exception handler for PHPMailer, extending PHP's built-in Exception class and adding a method to output a formatted error message.

methods.name: errorMessage
methods.description: Returns the error message formatted as HTML with strong tags and htmlspecialchars to prevent XSS.
